definition.def: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.
examples: It is appropriate that Irish names dominate the list.
Dress neatly and attractively in an outfit appropriate to the job.
The teacher can then take appropriate action.

definition.def: If someone appropriates something which does not belong to them, they take it, usually without the right to do so. [formal]
examples: Several other newspapers have appropriated the idea. [VERB noun]
The land was simply appropriated by the rulers. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If a government or organization appropriates an amount of money for a particular purpose, it reserves it for that purpose. [formal]
examples: The legislature authorized the raising of an army and appropriated money to supply it with weapons.  [VERB noun]
